title: Bases on the far side of the Moon

tellings.quote: So, you would have bases there, but you have them on the far side interestingly enough. It's almost as if you're afraid we'll see them.
And from what I've seen, there is something behind it hidden back there.
tellings.difference: Bledsoe says 'something', not bases, and rests it on photos he has seen.
tellings.link_reason: Both claim something is hidden on the far side of the Moon, out of our sight.

as_told.title: Something hidden on the far side of the Moon

plain: The claim is that something has been built on the far side of the Moon, the side that never faces Earth. John Brandenburg, a scientist who argues that Mars once had life, says on the show that there would be bases there, and that putting them on the far side is 'almost as if you're afraid we'll see them.' He gives it as his own reasoning, without a source. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs appear around him, goes less far: he says that from Moon photos he has seen, 'there is something behind it hidden back there.' If either is right, someone other than us is active on the Moon and hiding it from view.
